description: Puccini opera, staged by Theater Heidelberg
details:
Puccini's opera Tosca in a production of Theater und Orchester Heidelberg in the Marguerre-Saal of the city theatre. The drama of the singer Floria Tosca, the painter Cavaradossi and the police chief Scarpia is set in Rome in 1800; about 2.5 hours, recommended from 15.

November and December dates per the theatre calendar: 2, 8, 10, 15, 28 and 30 November (30 Nov sold out), 6 and 25 December, with an introduction 45 minutes before most shows. Tickets from 25.60 EUR (mvp.de); more dates until April 2027.
